title: The manifest help leaves the `fields` reading unassigned for several mutating commands (milestone/decision/draft create+edit, task complete/close, migration backlog apply)
description:
Found by QCLI-461's review round 2 (opum-control review seq 8052, head 97bc8933), non-blocking. QCLI-461 made the manifest advertise the COMPLETE top-level key set for the read commands task list, task view and search, and the manifest help now states three readings for a `fields` array: (1) the complete key set for those three reads, (2) a curated subset for other reads (milestone/decision/draft views), and (3) the settable-INPUT vocabulary. Reading (3) names only `task create`, `task edit` and `task edit-batch` -- but several OTHER mutating commands carry an identically-shaped non-output `fields` set that the help assigns no reading to: `milestone create`/`milestone edit`/`milestone archive` (fields [archived,description,status,taskIds,title]), `decision create`/`decision edit` ([context,outcome,status,title]), `draft create` ([description,documentation,labels,title]), `task complete` ([finalSummary]), `task close` ([finalSummary,resolution]) and `migration backlog apply` ([digest]). Measured: `milestone create` returns payload keys {id,title,status,taskIds} while its declared fields are [archived,description,status,taskIds,title] -- so the set is neither the payload key set nor obviously the settable-input vocabulary.

PRACTICAL HARM IS A DOCUMENTATION GAP, NOT A WRONG CAPABILITY: the help's opening warning (the meaning is NOT uniform; do not assume one reading for all commands) already tells a consumer not to assume, so nothing is broken. The fix is to name which reading applies to those commands -- either extend category (3) to them, or give them their own stated reading.

Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The manifest help, or a per-command statement, assigns an explicit reading to the `fields` array of every command that carries a non-output set -- so a consumer of `milestone create`/`edit`/`archive`, `decision create`/`edit`, `draft create`, `task complete`/`close` and `migration backlog apply` can tell which meaning applies
